results.name: login uses persistent Firebase storage and obtains a three-day server lease
reload restores login and renews the expiry without asking for credentials
closing and reopening the browser profile restores the same login
new tab restores login and a return to the tab advances the shared expiry
Firebase token refresh alone does not extend the idle session
expired server lease logs out and cannot be revived by reloading
fresh credential login opens a new session and logout clears all tabs
